transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. It is so very nice to meet you, and thank you so much for taking the time to see me. 

Well, um... I hope I'm not making a fuss over nothing, but I've been having a bit of a hard time lately. I'm not sure if I'm going to explain this right, but I just feel like... like I cannot settle inside my own skin anymore. It feels a bit silly to admit at my age, really. But even when I am just completely worn out, and I know I should just be sitting still and resting, I get this feeling like I have to jump up and do the next thing. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm answering your question okay and giving you the right kind of information.
Have you also been feeling unusually upbeat or high in mood?

Oh, no, Doctor. No, I wouldn't say that at all. Um... I don't feel high in spirits or unusually happy, if that's what you mean. 

I hope it's okay to say that, but it's really just... well, just that restless, buzzing feeling I mentioned. I certainly don't feel like I'm on top of the world or anything like that. Am I making sense? I just want to be sure I'm understanding you correctly and giving you what you need.
Have you started any new medication or had any recent change in a medication dose?

Oh, no, I haven't. Um... no new medications or anything like that. I just take my regular things, the same as always. 

I wouldn't want to take anything new without checking with a doctor first, of course. I hope that's the right answer? I just want to make sure I'm not leaving anything important out that you might need to know.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

Oh, goodness, no. I wouldn't say I need less sleep. Um... I definitely still feel tired and need my rest, just like anyone my age would. 

I mean, even with that awful restless feeling, I still try to get a full night's sleep. I certainly don't feel like I can just skip sleeping and keep going, if that's what you're asking. I hope that's helpful? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions the right way.
Have you been feeling more irritable or on edge than usual?

Oh, I certainly hope not. I really try my very best to be pleasant with everyone. Um... I wouldn't say I've been irritable, no. 

I mean, maybe I get a little frustrated with myself sometimes when I can't seem to settle down, but I would never want to take that out on anyone else. I hope I haven't seemed on edge to you today? I just want to be helpful and polite. Did I answer that okay?
Do you find yourself worrying a lot more than usual?

Oh, goodness, no. I try very hard not to be a worrywart. Um... I just take things one day at a time, really. I wouldn't say I'm worrying more than usual at all. 

I know some people fret over every little thing, but I always try to look on the bright side so I'm not a bother to anyone. I hope that's a good thing? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. Is that what you needed to know?
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless lately?

Oh, my, no. I really do try to keep a smile on my face. Um... I definitely wouldn't say I feel hopeless or depressed at all. 

I try very hard to stay cheerful so I'm not a gloomy presence for anyone around me. I always think there's plenty to be grateful for, you know? I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need. Am I doing okay?
Have you been doing more than usual and feeling a strong drive to stay busy or keep working?

Oh, goodness, no. Since I'm not working anymore, I really just try to enjoy my quiet time. Um... I certainly don't have any sort of intense drive to just keep busy all hours of the day. 

I mean, I do try to keep the house nice and tidy, of course, just to do my part, but I wouldn't say I'm doing more than usual. I really try to pace myself so I don't get in anyone's way or cause a fuss. I hope it's alright that I take things a bit slower these days? I just try to be good and do what's expected of me. Did I explain that alright for you?
Have you noticed yourself talking much more than usual or feeling a strong need to keep talking?

Oh, dear, no. I... well, I always try to be a good listener, really. Um... I certainly wouldn't want to talk anyone's ear off or be a nuisance. 

I definitely don't feel any sort of pressure to just keep talking and talking. I mostly try to stay quiet and just speak when it's polite to do so, so I don't take up too much space. I hope I'm not talking too much right now, actually? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions properly. Is this exactly what you needed?
Have you been doing more activities than usual?

Oh, heavens, no. I really just stick to my usual routine, mostly around the house. Um... I wouldn't say I'm doing more activities at all, really. 

I just try to keep up with the daily chores so the house is pleasant for everyone, but nothing out of the ordinary. I certainly don't want to overdo it or make anyone worry about me taking on too much. I hope that's the right answer? I just want to be as helpful as I can. Am I doing alright with these questions?
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or life change?

Oh... well... I suppose, um, yes. I really hate to be a bother or sound like I'm making excuses, but... well, my husband passed away. That was about 1 year and 10 months ago now. 

And, um, I suppose that's when all of this really started causing real trouble for me. I try my very best to keep a brave face and just carry on, of course, but it's just been a bit harder to manage everything since he's been gone. 

I hope it's alright that I mentioned that? I certainly don't want to make things gloomy or overshare, I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to know. Is that the sort of thing you were asking about?
When you feel restless, do you also feel physically tense, like your muscles are tight?

Oh, um, no, I don't think so. I mean, when I get a little fidgety, it's mostly just... well, just needing to move about a bit or find a little chore to do. I wouldn't say my muscles get all tight or physically tense, really. 

I hope it's alright that I don't have that one? I feel a bit awful saying no when you're taking all this time to ask me these questions, but I just want to make sure I'm giving you the absolute truth. Am I still being helpful to you?
Do you find it hard to control the restlessness or worry once it starts?

Oh, heavens... well, I don't really have that kind of worry, if I'm being honest. It's not like a big, overwhelming thing that I can't control. 

I mean, sometimes I get a little flustered, like anyone would, but I wouldn't say I have trouble controlling it. I just try to take a breath and find something useful to do, you know? I really try not to let things get out of hand or make a fuss. 

I hope that makes sense? I just want to be sure I'm answering you properly. I don't want to sound like I'm a difficult person or anything. Am I doing okay with this one?
Before your husband passed away, had you also been a person who worried a lot most days?

Oh, goodness, no. No, I wouldn't say I was a worrier at all. I mean, I've always tried to look on the bright side of things, you know? 

I suppose... well, I was always busy, always doing things around the house or running errands, but not because I was worried. Just because there's always something to be done, isn't there? I really try my best not to be a fretful sort of person. I think it's so much better to just keep a positive attitude and not burden others with too much fussing. 

I hope it's okay that I don't fit that description? I really don't want to disappoint you if you were looking for a different answer. I just want to be as helpful and accurate as I can be. Is that alright?
Do you feel this restlessness and difficulty settling have been present most days even when you are not thinking about your husband or other stressors?

Oh, um... well, no, I wouldn't say it's an everyday sort of thing, especially not when I'm just going about my normal routine. 

I mean, I suppose I've always been someone who likes to keep busy and moving, but I wouldn't call it a restless feeling that bothers me most days. It's really just when I'm reminded of him, or if things get a bit overwhelming, that I might feel a little out of sorts. Otherwise, I just try to keep a smile on and stay productive, you know? 

I hope I'm explaining that right. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of how things are for me. Is that the kind of information you needed?
